parallel_reentry.finding: Parallel work landed before this delta and already closed the basic deterministic NODE_RESULT-to-existing-model-call equality/transplant gap.

new_gap.source_observation: The current single-envelope controller bindings include expected source-bound model_call identity and model_output identity. Those values are products of the call and therefore cannot literally be known in an independently frozen pre-call invocation commitment.
new_gap.consequence: A frozen digest over a post-call binding proves deterministic equality and rejects later mutation relative to that digest, but by itself does not prove that cell/node/membership/candidate/input/source were committed before the model outcome existed.
new_gap.scope_boundary: This is not evidence that the current gates are incorrect as post-call integrity gates. It means they cannot alone mint stronger pre-call causal invocation provenance.

hypothesis.H1: A two-phase authority contract closes the temporal ambiguity without creating a second model-call identity: phase A freezes a pre-call launch descriptor over outcome-independent invocation facts; phase B records a post-call executor observation that references phase A and the already-existing exact source-bound model-call/output/ABI identities.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: One trusted post-call controller binding is sufficient because the deterministic controller can faithfully record all fields after execution.
hypothesis.counterassessment: That can support a narrower trusted post-call integrity claim. It does not independently demonstrate that route/cell/node/candidate/input/source assignment was fixed before outcome observation, so it is weaker for checkpoint-selection, causal J-Space attribution and anti-transplant provenance.
hypothesis.cheapest_discriminator: Source-only phase split with frozen launch_descriptor_sha256 and executor_observation_sha256, plus call/cell/output/source/self-mint/cohort negative controls. Runtime promotion remains blocked until an admitted executor proves actual phase timing and producer authenticity.

new_source_delta.authority_envelope: Deterministically composes immutable raw NODE_RESULT packet digest + phase A + phase B + existing exact model-call identity. It is a provenance envelope identity, not a competing model-call identity.
new_source_delta.cohort_rule: Ten-member authority cohort requires one plan and unique cell/node/PID/launch/executor-observation/raw-packet identities; a malformed member fails the whole cohort.
new_source_delta.self_authentication_boundary: Neither expected commitment is self-authenticating. An admitted executor must independently attest and freeze phase A before the call and phase B after the call. Source-only equality is zero runtime credit.

external_research_context.source: SLSA Provenance v1.2 and build provenance model
external_research_context.relevance: Modern provenance models separate the definition/input side of an invocation from run/output details and treat provenance as verifiable information about where, when and how an artifact was produced. This supports keeping pre-execution invocation commitments distinct from post-execution observations rather than collapsing both into one post-hoc record.
external_research_context.nonclaim: SLSA does not prove this Trigger-2 implementation and does not mint any EntityOS/HCU runtime credit.
